title.en: Ozone cracking names the sections; concrete pump integral piston φ180 keeps the printed cells
title.zh: 《Ozone cracking》只提供章节，concrete pump integral piston φ180仍用已印格子

description.en: The concrete pump integral piston φ180 note follows the outline of Ozone cracking. A φ180 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ180 as its piston.
description.zh: concrete pump integral piston φ180这篇笔记顺着《Ozone cracking》的大纲写。φ180 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ180 写成自己的活塞。

h1.en: How Ozone cracking arranges a note that only repeats concrete pump integral piston φ180
h1.zh: 《Ozone cracking》怎样安排一篇只重复concrete pump integral piston φ180的笔记

directAnswer.en: For concrete pump integral piston φ180, copy the printed fragments and ignore any urge to borrow a figure from Ozone cracking. Ozone cracking only lends its headings. A φ180 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ180 as its piston.
directAnswer.zh: 写concrete pump integral piston φ180时，只抄已印片段，不要从来源页《Ozone cracking》借数字。《Ozone cracking》只出借标题。 φ180 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ180 写成自己的活塞。

body.en: Where the source outline says “Susceptible elastomers”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. The integral piston page lists φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250, sold per piece, as replacement parts rather than OEM parts of other brands. This note is only φ180. Rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane are printed on the split-piston page, not as a material for this integral row. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The split-piston page also lists φ180, with its own material row and a set as the unit. Same outer diameter does not merge the two parts. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write integral piston, φ180, and the quantity in pieces. Do not add a material the page does not print. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“来源章节：Susceptible elastomers”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 整体活塞页列出 φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250，按个供货，并写明是替换件，不是其他品牌原厂件。本文只写 φ180。橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯印在分体活塞页上，不是这一整体活塞行的材料。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。分体活塞页也有 φ180，那边有自己的材料行，单位是套。外径相同也不会把两件配件并成一件。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明整体活塞、φ180 和个数。不要补上页面没有印的材料。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Form of cracking”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. A φ180 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ180 as its piston. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“来源章节：Form of cracking”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 φ180 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ180 写成自己的活塞。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: Nothing about the phrase “Ozonolysis” is a second data sheet. The data-sheet fragment, if one was printed, is quoted next. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: “来源章节：Ozonolysis”这几个字不是第二张数据表。若目录印过数据，下面引用的才是那一句。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: Read “Prevention” as the source author’s section, not as a Pinjin test result. The sentence that follows is the printed fragment. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 整体活塞 page plus this size and the quantity. The heading stops there. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ozone_cracking
body.zh: 把“预防”读成来源作者的分节，不要读成品锦的试验结果。后面跟的是已印片段。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明整体活塞这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 标题到此为止。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ozone_cracking

question.en: Why is Ozone cracking not a source of extra ratings for concrete pump integral piston φ180?
question.zh: 为什么《Ozone cracking》不能给concrete pump integral piston φ180增加额定值？

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
